Notes: XP needed to go from level 1 to level 2.
Each level needs this many times the previous level's XP (1.2 = +20% per level).
Chance for a killed enemy to drop an experience token.
XP per token when there is no running wave to calculate it from (e.g. test scenes).
Levels a player should gain per wave from base tokens alone. Enhanced tokens add on top of this.
Share of the expected spawns the player is expected to kill before the wave ends.
Spawn interval used for the estimate: 0 = the wave's regular cooldown, 1 = its long cooldown. Fast killers keep few enemies alive and stay on the long cooldown more often.
Extra XP per point of the Experience Reduction stat (0.1 = +10% per point), so each point makes the player level the same amount faster at every level.
